name: Fire Lash
description: You strike out at a target in range with a burning lash,  Make a melee attack on a creature, doing {dice} {type} damage.  On a successful attack, the targeted creature must make a {save}.  On a fail, allies add +1 to any attack targeted at the creature for the duration.  This modifier can be stacked if it fails multiple Fire Lash saves, up to a maximum of +5.
